description: This file defines a custom exception class ResourceNotFoundException used in a Spring Boot application to handle 404 Not Found HTTP responses.

classes.name: ResourceNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class annotated with @ResponseStatus to correspond with HTTP 404 Not Found error. Extends RuntimeException to indicate an unchecked exception.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a detail message.
